name: Zenrows
description: Live web data: fetch any public page as Markdown, HTML or text, pull structured fields from it as JSON, run batch jobs over many URLs, crawl a site from one start URL and drive a hosted browser for pages that need clicks, forms or pagination, with proxies, JavaScript rendering and anti-bot protection handled by Zenrows.

zenrows.description: Enable this plugin and connect your Zenrows account in OpenClaw. A Zenrows account is required; usage is billed by Zenrows.
